programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.desc: Planet Earth - a cosmic sphere. Our home. A lump of rock - which, for many thousands of years - has been viewed as a living, thinking thing - Mother Earth. programme.title: Paul Merton: Driving Amazing Trains

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS

programme.desc: Recounts the epic saga and follows the lives of Leandro Illin and a Ngadjon woman, Kitty Clarke, a traditional owner of the land. Pioneers of Love begins by telling the story of how, in 1910, the Illins, a family of aristocratic Russian dissidents, fled to Australia to escape persecution. Tropical north Queensland is where Leandro met Kitty, a 20-year-old widow with three children and this program tells the story of Leandro and Kitty's battle to be granted permission to be recognised as husband and wife and the backlash they received because of this request. In the midst of this, xenophobia began to sweep Australia. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary) (Part 1 of 2) (Rpt) PG CC WS

programme.title: Pioneers Of Love
programme.desc: The second part of Pioneers of Love looks at how after the The Bolshevik Revolution of 1918 and the backlash from the Brisbane Red Flag riots, many of the Illin family left for South America. But the law of the early 20th century prevented full-blood Aborigines from travelling. Thus Leandro remained behind with Kitty and their children. Disillusioned, Leandro withdrew to a remote outback location, taking his family with him. Tragedy struck when Kitty, isolated and far from medical assistance, died after enduring a complicated birth. With his wife and newborn child dead, Leandro moved the family closer to civilisation, at Greenvale station. (Commissioned by SBS, in English) (Documentary Series) (Rpt) G CC WS
